name: rota-triage-bot
description: REMEX rota-triage: unattended Slack alert triage (tag → Kibana → GitHub → thread + team channel reply), multi-team, hosted on Agent1.

metadata.description: Install locally with: claude plugin marketplace add <path-or-url of this repo>; the Agent1 scheduled task reads the same files from a clone of this repo.

plugins.name: rota-triage
plugins.description: Finds Slack messages that tag a configured user group in configured channels, resolves the Kibana link, analyses the logs (Kibana agents + deterministic search), locates the failing code in the owning wkda repo, and posts the analysis in the alert thread and the team channel. Usage- /rota-triage:rota-triage poll --monitor <team> [--dry-run] | --since 3d | <slack-permalink>
